text:
anya: Starting negotiation thread for curated beta scope & partner SLAs. Need to finalize what we will and won't do for the 8-week pilot. Goal: clear boundaries so engineering time is predictable.
katie: Can we list must-have rollback points and what we explicitly won't customize? e.g., we won't do deep model retraining during the pilot.
ryan: Agree. Must-haves: onboarding automation, preflight script, KMS integration, network checklist, and a fallback to Dedicated if on-prem drags. Won't-do: custom model forks, multi-week latency optimization, bespoke telemetry pipelines.
lee: For ops, we need exact provisioning SLAs per deployment type. Proposed: VPC provisioning <= 3 business days; assisted on-prem <= 7 business days; on-prem with on-site visit is out of scope for pilot unless pre-approved.
devon: Intake will include a checkbox: "requires onsite assistance". If checked, we mark partner as "needs exec approval". Also adding checkbox: "consent to anonymized usage + error traces".
anya: Good. Legal: any special language we need to include for telemetry and crash logs?
legal: We'll need an addendum that covers anonymized telemetry, retention window (90 days), and scope-limited access for our SREs. No customer PII in logs. We can provide a template.
katie: For success criteria suggest pragmatic gates: (A) onboarding completed within SLA for first wave (2 partners) AND (B) automated preflight runs without manual remediation for >=2 partners OR (C) partner satisfaction >=7/10. Need at least 2 of 3 to pass wave.
ryan: I want a measurable latency gate: 95th pctl < target SLO for 10 business days before we label a partner "success". If a partner consistently misses latency but is otherwise satisfied, mark as "needs perf follow-up" and not GA signoff.
anya: How about rollouts / scope negotiation: we allow small config changes (batch-size, quantization flag) but refuse architecture changes or new model onboarding during the pilot. All model upgrades must be from our verified model catalog.
devon: I'll add a "config change request" form for partners to submit; config changes reviewed within 3 business days. If approval needed beyond that, we'll escalate.
lee: Also capture expected QPS & token lengths in intake; helps kernel selection and capacity planning. Recommend fields: avg qps/min, 95th token length, concurrency requirements.
katie: Compensation: keep it simple: either $ credit for Hosted/Dedicated usage or a fixed allotment of eng-hours for assisted on-prem. No custom contracts.
anya: Final ask: legal to share telemetry addendum draft by 1765555200; devon to publish intake + scoring rubric by 1765555000; lee to publish provisioning checklist + preflight POC by 1765555400; katie to draft outreach copy with compensation by 1765555600. I'll consolidate and schedule an invite-only kickoff next week. :white_check_mark:
